notes: The list covers essentially all of Mendelssohn's original violin works: three sonatas, two concertos and the double concerto with piano, plus the main established arrangements. The only further item I can name with confidence is Ferdinand David's published set of Songs without Words arrangements; other Lieder ohne Worte transcriptions are either covered by the existing 'May Breezes' entry or too obscure.
